name: news-follow-buttons
description: A customizable Gutenberg block with buttons linking to Google News, Discover, and preferred-source settings.
author: Popa Zelu Andrei

scripts.make-pot: npx @wordpress/env run cli wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/news-follow-buttons wp-content/plugins/news-follow-buttons/languages/news-follow-buttons.pot --exclude=node_modules,vendor,build
scripts.make-json: npx @wordpress/env run cli wp i18n make-json wp-content/plugins/news-follow-buttons/languages --no-purge
